chunks.sanskrit: jadājaḍānām apy evaṃ % nāsty asāv iti niścayaḥ naitat svarūpaṃ spṛśati % vastuno jñātṛgāmy adaḥ parāpekṣitayā naika- % rūpatve sattvalaṅghanāt siddhyaty eva viśeṣo 'tra % tāvatā ca prayojanam tadapekṣāṃ vinā bhāvā- % bhāvayor aviśiṣṭatā kuryān nānyas tathāpy artho % nirviśeṣo nijātmani sann arthaḥ syāt svarūpeṇa % nāsatas tu viśiṣyate samam evānayos tena % pratiṣṭhā saṃvidāśrayā abhāvena jaḍenātha % tulyaiva prāgvad ātmani
chunks.l4:
As real and unreal carry no mark between them, in own self —
so inert and non-inert carry none. This stands certain.
Appearing, describing — being, and non-being its reverse —
none of it touches own-form. That essence faces the knower.
A thing's self can never be mere object of showing-telling:
it leans on another, keeps no single form, oversteps being.
Granted — let no mark stand. Yet here a difference succeeds,
from appearing's coming and going — and that much serves the end.
Even so, being fits only as bound to appearing —
cut from that tie, thing and unthing stay one blur.
But how keep they one, when the existent performs its function,
and the other does not? — Yet the thing, in own self, stays without mark.
Steeped in the working-shine dye, the existent would subsist
by its own form — yet differ from the non-existent nowhere.
But even there, no working is declared of the already-proven thing —
the two run level. So their ground stands on awareness.
And were awareness ungrasping in its very form,
it too would rank with non-being, with the inert — as before.

chunks.sanskrit: katham anyasya bhāvasya % pratiṣṭhāspadatām iyāt pratiṣṭhātmakatāṃ gacched % aham ity ātmanā punaḥ vyavasthitiḥ pratiṣṭhā ca % siddhir nirvṛttir ucyate jaḍāḥ prakāśa evāsti % svātmanaḥ svaparātmabhiḥ muktvānvayasya prakāśasya % vimarśarahitātmanaḥ yā svasvarūpe viśrāntir % vimarśaḥ so 'ham ity ayam prāṇādinā niruddho 'ṇuḥ % paramātmā tv akhaṇḍitaḥ eka evānusandhānād % ato 'nyo nopapadyate bhāti paryantavartinyāṃ % bhāsanād adhikaṃ jaḍam
chunks.l4:
Unwon in final grounding, even by her become self-nature —
how would she bear another being's ground, its standing-place?
Saying 'this,' awareness grows fit to ground another's shine —
saying 'I,' it grounds itself.
By parting and by pairing both, assurance stands declared —
fixed order, ground, attainment, full close — of the other inert selves.
So these inert ones, near-unreal in themselves, are shining's —
shining alone is — of its own self, through selves both own and other.
Apart from distinct-and-indistinct assurance, no experience stands —
none apart from linked shining, whose self is ungrasping.
Cut off, this 'this'-grasping finds fulfillment thus:
rest in own form — that grasp, 'I am this,' is this itself.
One self, twofold: measured and unmeasured —
breath-bound, an atom; supreme self, unbroken.
For both, this one end-ground of all thing-awarenesses —
one through linking alone. So no other can stand.
And in I-knowing whose self is non-parting grasp, limit-dwelling —
nothing inert past shining shows.

chunks.sanskrit: tat prāṇādi prameyaṃ syān % na pramātānyato bhramāt jīve niruddhā tatrāpi % paramātmani sā sthitā sādhitā pratyabhijñāyām % akhyāter jīvatā param prakāśasyātmaviśrāntir % ahaṃbhāvo hi kīrtitaḥ svātantryam atha kartṛtvaṃ % mukhyam īśvaratāpi ca tadakhyātimayaṃ hy etaj % jagannirmātṛteśitā svasaṃvedanaparyāya- % mātṛtattvam anādi tat vyāpitvam anusaṃdhānaṃ % taj jaḍasya na yujyate tenoktam pratyabhijñāyāṃ % tadadvayamayaṃ jagat
chunks.l4:
Unproved by never spreading — though knowing-clad and all —
breath and kin rank knowable, never knower. Else, straying.
Though things stand locked in the living,
by breath and eightfold-city curbed — even there, in the supreme self it dwells.
How could breath ever prove its hold on that self-nature?
In recognition — by living-ness, past non-showing.
No ordering of things lies in breath by I-blocking —
shining's self-rest is sung as I-ness.
Rest, already told — that very rest, all dependence barred:
freedom, foremost doing, and lordship in its train.
Māyā by name, from his power only — no other proved:
this world-maker lordship is made of non-showing.
Through linking alone is she proclaimed — of all awarenesses
the mother-reality, self-feeling's own name — beginningless.
Whatever grounds thing-ordering — pervasion and linking
of the I-sharer — fits nothing inert.
So within difference, shining's shining holds good —
hence recognition's word: this world is that-nondual-made.
